description: Frozen, non-fuzzy mapping rules from NCI-ALMANAC cell labels to CellMiner NCI-60 RNA-seq columns.

known_source_alias_groups.reason: The control-character variant shares PANELNBR=12 and CELLNBR=16 and is not a separate biological cell.

lineage_policy: Known shared-origin families are indivisible in the strict CellOut protocol; all unlisted cells form singleton groups.
